issues.title: Conflicting Default Overwrite Semantics
issues.why: 01-install-contract.md states 'Overwrite existing files silently (legacy behavior)' as default, but AC-07 in 97-acceptance-criteria.md states 'refuse to proceed (exit 2) UNLESS --force is passed'.
issues.fix: Update 01-install-contract.md to match AC-07's safety-first requirement: default to exit 2 on conflict.

issues.title: Missing Runner Help Output Example
issues.why: The spec mandates a specific table format for the 'help' sub-command but does not provide the actual text/markdown block for the AI to copy-paste into the code.
issues.fix: Add a 'Sample Help Output' block to 02-runner-contract.md showing the exact text to be printed.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'git pull' behavior in Runner
issues.why: 02-runner-contract.md mandates 'git pull' for slides/lint but doesn't specify behavior if the directory is not a git repo or if there are local conflicts.
issues.fix: Specify that 'git pull' should be attempted only if .git exists, and failures should be non-fatal warnings.
